terms.definition: Security, policy, data and billing isolation boundary.
invariants: Every platform object belongs to exactly one Tenant.

terms.definition: Long-lived, objective-driven unit of governed business execution across interactions.
invariants: Stable EngagementId across channels.
A Profile specializes but never replaces this aggregate.

terms.definition: A separately measurable and verifiable item inside an Engagement.
invariants: Belongs to one Engagement.
Item type is a Profile discriminator, not a new Authority.

terms.definition: Versioned specialization contract for schema, policy, metrics, UI and dependencies.
invariants: Cannot own a platform Authority.
Failure is scoped to the Profile.

terms.definition: Immutable binding from an Engagement to a Profile contract version.
invariants: Exactly one active Profile version per binding generation.

terms.definition: Versioned intended business result with measurable policy.
invariants: Does not equal an AI prompt or call disposition.

terms.definition: One continuous participation window that may span communication sessions.
invariants: Stable across media switches.
Does not equal a Call or Room.

terms.definition: A bounded communication realization linked to native communication Authorities.
invariants: References, but does not own, Call and Room state.

terms.definition: Leased human or AI work unit with bounded context and handoff.
invariants: Task execution cannot finalize an Action or Outcome by itself.

terms.definition: Provenance, consent, retention and integrity-bound observation used by verification.
invariants: Candidate AI output is not verified Evidence.
Evidence is append-only by revision.

terms.definition: Intent, authorization, attempt, receipt, verification and compensation lifecycle for an external effect.
invariants: Network delivery is not exactly once.
Unknown effects require query/reconcile.

terms.definition: Versioned claim that an Objective result occurred under a VerificationPolicy.
invariants: Only Finalized claims may later become billable.
Disputes use immutable reversal or credit.

terms.definition: Resolve Profile projection of an Engagement.
invariants: Never the horizontal platform root.
Uses the same Engagement Authority.

terms.definition: Resolve Profile projection of a problem EngagementItem.
invariants: Uses the same EngagementItem Authority.

terms.definition: Telephony business object owned by the selected telephony Authority.
invariants: Referenced by CommunicationSession; never the platform root.
Referenced by CommunicationSession; never the platform root.

terms.definition: Formal Case, Ticket or WorkOrder retained by the customer system in Overlay.
invariants: Converact never mirrors a second formal Authority.
